description: This file implements the FinishSetupSource class, which is responsible for finalizing the setup of media sources in a GStreamer-based media player. It includes callback functions for GStreamer appsrc events and the execution logic to attach media streams (audio and video) to the GStreamer pipeline, and notify the client of the playback state.

classes.name: FinishSetupSource
classes.description: A class responsible for completing the setup of media sources in the GStreamer pipeline, attaching audio and video streams, and notifying the client of the playback state.

methods.name: FinishSetupSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FinishSetupSource object with the given context, player, and client.

methods.name: ~FinishSetupSource
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the FinishSetupSource object.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the setup of media sources, attaches them to the GStreamer pipeline, and notifies the client that the player is in the IDLE state.
